name: Child Dedication
overview: Child Dedication in Scripture emphasizes recognizing children as a sacred heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents to nurture and guide. The command to sanctify the firstborn to God (Exodus 13:2) underscores God's claim over children, while Deuteronomy 6:5-7 instructs parents to diligently teach and love God with all their heart, soul, and might, passing this devotion to their children. Psalms 127:3 affirms that children are a reward from God, and Proverbs 22:6 highlights the responsibility to train children in the way they should go so they remain faithful throughout life.
